decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core upholstery offer that was given its own page, it reflects visible commitment and likely enough sunk design and launch effort that management would be inclined to continue with it.

Although it seems to have received less public emphasis than some other launches, it still fits the firm's decorative textile range well and management can plausibly treat any slow uptake as temporary in a growing market.
This product combines clear functional value for contract customers with a dedicated product page, so the firm is likely to stay committed rather than admit an early reversal.

Its website treatment suggests more limited public commitment, but it still builds on the established assortment and a medium-sized German textile firm with broad collections would usually retain such a recent line for longer.

This appears to be the most niche and least visibly committed of the launches, yet because it was only recently introduced and still supports the firm's established decorative fabric direction, management is more likely to persist than to withdraw it now.
